stories.headline: Christina Applegate reveals she was misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis: "Not happy at all" - CBS News
stories.summary: Christina Applegate said on her MeSsy podcast that her doctor recently revealed she did not have multiple sclerosis.

stories.headline: 'You Can See Everything' Wins Monday Box Office; Looks to Take Down 'Clayface' - Deadline
stories.summary: 'You Can See Everything' wins Monday box office with $2.5M. Documentary has shot at taking out 'Clayface' at box office.

stories.headline: Sir Paul McCartney and Ringo Starr back new Beatles attraction - BBC
stories.summary: The surviving Beatles have welcomed plans for an immersive visitor experience in Liverpool.

stories.headline: Kyle Kennedy, granddaughter of Bobby and Ethel Kennedy, dead at 42 - Page Six
stories.summary: Kyle’s tragic passing comes six years after she suffered a severe spinal cord injury in 2020. She is survived by sons Conor and Declan.

stories.headline: Roseanne Barr Breaks Silence on High-Stakes TV Return: “Who Wants a Number One Show?” - The Hollywood Reporter
stories.summary: Eight years after ABC fired her over a tweet widely condemned as racist, the former sitcom queen opens up about her estranged TV family, sides with ex-husband Tom Arnold against Chuck Lorre and bets…

stories.headline: Jay-Z reportedly selects himself for Super Bowl LXI halftime show in Los Angeles at SoFi Stadium - Fox News
stories.summary: Jay-Z reportedly chose himself over Miley Cyrus, Justin Bieber, and Harry Styles to headline the Super Bowl LXI halftime show at SoFi Stadium.

stories.headline: Harry says he wants to 'work it out' with his family - BBC
stories.summary: Prince Harry says he wants reconciliation with his family, in an interview with a magazine in New York last month.

stories.headline: Feud with Ben Affleck key to Netflix boss’ firing: ‘I’m not talking to them anymore’ - Page Six
stories.summary: Ben Affleck may have played an even bigger role in film boss Dan Lin being shown the door at Netflix, as intrigue spikes over who will take over new roles at the streamer, as well as Warner Bros.

moments.author: ERCboxoffice
moments.quote: This doc is totally hot. A24’s YOU CAN SEE EVERYTHING delivered $5.5M on Friday (including previews) and is completely taking over the social media discourse.
moments.why: Because it highlighted the documentary’s unexpectedly strong Friday box office performance and social media buzz, drawing widespread attention.
